Do not update installed Remotion Agent Skills while upgrading Remotion.

## CLI flag

Use `--skip-skills` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                 | Flag            |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade) | `--skip-skills` |
